newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish minister seeks early grain duty restoration.
newsitem.headline: Polish minister seeks early grain duty restoration.

text.p: Polish Agriculture Minister Jaroslaw Kalinowski said on Thursday he will press the government to revive a 20-percent grain import duty earlier than on June 30 as planned.
"I will take action aimed at restoring the 20-percent grain duty. The issue will be discussed at the government meeting on Tuesday," Kalinowski told a news conference.
Last month, the government rejected Kalinowski's request that the 20 percent duty, suspended in 1996 and reimposed at 10 percent for most grains earlier this year, be restored immediately.
Kalinowski said an earlier return to the higher duty would be aimed at helping domestic grain producers, likely to be hit by cheaper imports which could fill silos before this year's harvest.
